KJV.displayText: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;

BSB.text: Consider it pure joy, my brothers, when you encounter trials of many kinds,
BSB.displayText: Consider it pure joy, my brothers, when you encounter trials of many kinds,

CPDV.text: My brothers, when you have fallen into various trials, consider everything a joy,
CPDV.displayText: My brothers, when you have fallen into various trials, consider everything a joy,

verses.context: Writing to Jewish believers scattered by persecution, James startles them with an unexpected instruction: to consider it pure joy whenever they face various trials.

KJV.text: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
KJV.displayText: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:

BSB.text: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
BSB.displayText: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

CPDV.text: For you were darkness, in times past, but now you are light, in the Lord. So then, walk as sons of the light.
CPDV.displayText: For you were darkness, in times past, but now you are light, in the Lord. So then, walk as sons of the light.

verses.context: Reminding the Ephesians of who they now are, Paul contrasts their former life in spiritual darkness with their present identity as people who live in the light.
